title: From Brand Authority to Gated Release
subtitle: A process view of the kernel: brand pack decides, specialists produce, deterministic tools render, a gate verifies.

tiers.title: Brand pack authority
tiers.summary: The owning brand pack sets color, type, motion and copy.

tiers.title: Specialist routing
tiers.summary: The design orchestrator calls one bounded specialist per stage.

tiers.title: Deterministic render
tiers.summary: Exact text and charts compile to SVG and HTML; no model-drawn labels.

tiers.title: Independent release gate
tiers.summary: Distinct maker, verifier and approver before release.
